svg.aria-label: Protege WX for Home Assistant. Home Assistant integration. Arm, disarm and unlock doors on an ICT Protege WX, and see who did what, about once a second. Works through the controller's own web interface, so no Automation licence is needed. Comes with its own alarm card and works in Apple Home.
